name: MonarchPreJoinLobby
title: PreJoinLobby
wrapsNative: androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Column with BoxWithConstraints for the preview area; MonarchCallControls (Material 3 FilledIconToggleButton), MonarchAudioLevelMeter, MonarchAvatarGroup, MonarchBanner and MonarchButton. The camera preview is the app's (CameraX PreviewView through AndroidView) in a slot
summary: The screen before joining a call: the camera preview, the microphone level, device choice, the people already in the call, and joining with the microphone or camera off.
whenToUse: Before starting or joining an audio or video call, so people can check how they look and sound and choose their devices before anyone sees or hears them.
whenNotToUse: During the call, use MonarchCallControls and MonarchCallStage. To change devices in the middle of a call, use MonarchDevicePicker in a sheet. For an incoming call, the app posts a call notification (incoming-call).
api: @ExperimentalMonarchApi @Composable fun MonarchPreJoinLobby(micOn: Boolean, onMicOnChange: (Boolean) -> Unit, onJoin: (micOn: Boolean, cameraOn: Boolean) -> Unit, icon: @Composable (control: MonarchCallControl, on: Boolean) -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, cameraOn: Boolean = false, onCameraOnChange: ((Boolean) -> Unit)? = null, audioLevel: Float = 0f, participants: List<MonarchPreJoinLobbyParticipant> = emptyList(), joining: Boolean = false, showTitle: Boolean = true, error: String? = null, joinLabel: String? = null, labels: MonarchPreJoinLobbyLabels = MonarchPreJoinLobbyLabels(), onCancel: (() -> Unit)? = null, devices: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, preview: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null)
class MonarchPreJoinLobbyParticipant(name: String, image: Painter? = null)

class MonarchPreJoinLobbyLabels(title: String? = null, preview: String? = null, cameraOff: String? = null, startingCamera: String? = null, noPreview: String? = null, micLevel: String? = null, muted: String? = null, participants: String? = null, alreadyIn: ((count: Int) -> String)? = null, cancel: String? = null, join: String? = null, joining: String? = null, callControls: MonarchCallControlsLabels = MonarchCallControlsLabels())

options.name: micOn
options.description: Whether the person joins with the microphone on.

options.name: onMicOnChange
options.description: Receives the new microphone choice from the Microphone toggle.

options.name: icon
options.description: Draws the glyph of the microphone and camera toggles for each state, as for MonarchCallControls. Monarch bundles no icons.

options.name: cameraOn
options.description: Whether the person joins with the camera on; the preview shows the app's video only then.

options.name: onCameraOnChange
options.description: Shows the Camera toggle. Leave it out for audio-only calls.

options.name: audioLevel
options.description: The microphone loudness from 0 to 1, measured by the app, shown in a bar meter.

options.name: participants
options.description: The people already in the call: up to five small avatars, a +N tile and N already in the call.

options.name: joining
options.description: The join button shows progress and Joining… as its state; the toggles and Cancel are disabled.

options.name: showTitle
options.description: Shows the Join the call heading. Turn it off when the screen or dialog already has a title.

options.name: error
options.description: A problem getting the preview, shown in a danger MonarchBanner; the preview then says No preview.

options.name: joinLabel
options.description: The join button's text, such as Start call. Join now by default.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for every built-in string, including the toggles' MonarchCallControlsLabels.

options.name: onCancel
options.description: Shows a Cancel button before the join button.

options.name: devices
options.description: The device choice, usually MonarchDevicePicker with the small size.

options.name: preview
options.description: The app's camera preview, shown while cameraOn is on; it fills the preview area.

states.name: camera off
states.description: The preview area, in the muted background, says Camera is off.

states.name: camera starting
states.description: The camera is on but the app gives no preview yet: Starting camera….

states.name: camera on
states.description: The app's preview fills the area, which is at least a 16:9 picture of the lobby's width.

states.name: microphone off
states.description: The meter is empty in the disabled color and reads Muted; the Microphone toggle reads Off.

states.name: error
states.description: A danger banner with the message, announced politely, and No preview in the preview area.

states.name: joining
states.description: The join button shows a progress indicator and Joining… for TalkBack; the toggles and Cancel are disabled.

states.name: audio only
states.description: Without onCameraOnChange there is no Camera toggle.

appearance: The preview area uses the muted background role with Monarch's container radius and muted text; the toggles, meter, avatars, banner and buttons keep their own roles (the join button is primary, Cancel is ghost). The same roles adapt to dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: The web lobby takes a MediaStream, draws the video itself and measures the microphone with the Web Audio API. On Android capturing needs the camera and microphone permissions and CameraX or a call SDK, which belong to the app, so the lobby takes the preview as a slot (a CameraX PreviewView through AndroidView) and the level as audioLevel. The web overlays the meter and toggles on the video; Android places them under the preview, so they never sit on uncontrolled video colors. The web passes device picker props; Android takes a devices slot for a MonarchDevicePicker, which keeps the device lists and permission states in one place. The web hides the meter while muted; Android keeps it and reads Muted. Joining calls back with two booleans instead of a settings object. The title is shown or hidden with showTitle instead of a null title. iOS has no entry for this id yet.
accessibility: The preview area is one element named Your camera preview, followed by its placeholder text.
The Microphone and Camera toggles are MonarchCallControls toggles: one name each, On or Off as their state, 48dp targets.
The meter is named Microphone level and reads its percentage, or Muted, as its state.
The people in the call are a MonarchAvatarGroup named People in the call, with the count written next to it.
The error is a MonarchBanner announced through a polite live region.
While joining, the join button announces Joining… as its state and ignores taps.
edgeCases: At the largest font scale the preview grows taller than 16:9 when its placeholder text needs it.
An error wins over the camera state: the preview says No preview even with the camera on.
A level outside 0 to 1 is limited to that range by the meter.
More than five people show five avatars and a +N tile.

examples.title: In a dialog
An audio-only call with access blocked
examples.code:
@OptIn(ExperimentalMonarchApi::class)
MonarchPreJoinLobby(
    micOn = false,
    onMicOnChange = {},
    onJoin = { _, _ -> },
    icon = { control, on ->
        val glyph = when (control) {
            MonarchCallControl.Microphone -> if (on) SampleIcons.Mic else SampleIcons.MicOff
            MonarchCallControl.Camera -> if (on) SampleIcons.Video else SampleIcons.VideoOff
            MonarchCallControl.ShareScreen -> SampleIcons.ScreenShare
            MonarchCallControl.RaiseHand -> SampleIcons.RaiseHand
            MonarchCallControl.React -> SampleIcons.React
            MonarchCallControl.More -> SampleIcons.More
            MonarchCallControl.Leave -> SampleIcons.CallEnd
        }
        MonarchIcon(glyph, contentDescription = null)
    },
    showTitle = false,
    error = "Microphone access is blocked. Allow it in Settings.",
    joinLabel = "Start call",
)
